The positions are available in Gurugram, Jhajjar, Karnal, Palwal, Rewari, Sonepat and Panchkula. Candidates possessing 10+2 with the prescribed computer qualification, a three-year Diploma, BCA, B.Sc. in Computer Science/IT or other accepted qualifications can apply. how_to_apply: Visit the official HARTRON website at hartron.org.in.
Open the recruitment or Computer Professionals panel section.
Read the official notification, eligibility criteria and reservation instructions.
Open the Data Entry Operator online application link.
Complete the required registration process as instructed on the portal.

Review all information and verify that it matches the original certificates.
Pay any applicable charges shown by the official portal.

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: HARTRON has announced the application period and admit card availability date for the Data Entry Operator panel. The exact test schedule will be communicated through the official website. Important: HARTRON states that candidates must download their admit cards from its website. Individual communication regarding admit cards and subsequent recruitment updates will not be sent separately.

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Vacancy 2026 - 110 Posts
content_sections.text: Candidates should carefully select their preferred district while applying because the panel is maintained district-wise.

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Recruitment 2026 Reservation Details
content_sections.text: Reservation Clarification: The 12 PwD positions are included within the 110 advertised positions and must not be added separately. The reservation guidelines state that eligible SC, BCA, BCB, EWS, PwD and Ex-Servicemen candidates must be bona fide residents of Haryana and possess valid supporting documents by the last date of online application. The Haryana Government has subdivided Scheduled Castes into Deprived Scheduled Castes (DSC) and Other Scheduled Castes (OSC) for reservation purposes. Eligible candidates must possess certificates clearly identifying their relevant subcategory. Important: Candidates claiming EWS reservation must possess an EWS certificate valid for Haryana Government employment. A certificate issued only for Central Government employment is not accepted under the supplied reservation guidelines.

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Salary 2026
content_sections.text: The uploaded document titled Eligibility Criteria for Computer Professionals on Job Work Basis specifies remuneration of Rs. 23,400 for the Data Entry Operator category. Important: The position is offered on a job-work basis. The remuneration should not be presented as a permanent Government employee's basic pay or pay-matrix salary. Candidates should confirm the applicable remuneration when a deployment offer is issued.

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: HARTRON will conduct the recruitment test for updating its panel of Data Entry Operators. The uploaded documents identify the computerized test subjects and provide a five-minute sample typing paper. The candidate selection and empanelment process involves: Online application submission. Verification of submitted eligibility and reservation details. Online computerized test. Typing test, as prescribed. Preparation and publication of the panel. Verification of documents and suitability when required. Deployment against confirmed departmental or organizational requirements.

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Exam Pattern and Syllabus 2026
content_sections.text: The supplied Topics and Sample Papers document specifies four major topics for the online computerized test. Candidates should prepare basic office-computing concepts related to MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint and other common office applications. Useful preparation areas include document creation, editing, formatting, spreadsheet formulas and common computer shortcuts. The official syllabus includes Internet and HTML/DHTML. Candidates can revise web browsers, URLs, websites, basic internet terminology and introductory HTML concepts. This section covers the fundamentals of operating systems and computers. Candidates can revise Windows functions, files and folders, input/output devices, computer hardware, software and basic system operations. The syllabus also includes networking. Relevant preparation areas include LAN, WAN, networking devices, IP addresses, internet connectivity and basic network terminology. Syllabus Note: The four major subjects above are listed in the official sample-paper document. The additional preparation examples are explanatory study suggestions, not a separately notified detailed syllabus.

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Typing Test 2026
content_sections.text: The supplied sample-paper document includes a Data Entry Operator typing exercise with a duration of 5 minutes . The sample typing passage discusses HARTRON's role in e-Governance, software development, networking, consultancy, IT training and related services. Applicants should practise accurate typing at the prescribed speed. The sample paper specifies five minutes, but the complete operational test rules and error-calculation method should be checked in the current examination instructions.

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Recruitment 2026 Exam Centres
content_sections.text: Candidates should refer to their admit cards for the exact reporting address, date, time and examination instructions.

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Admit Card 2026
content_sections.text: The HARTRON DEO Admit Card 2026 will be available for download from 1 December 2026 onwards through the official HARTRON website. The short notice states that individual admit card communications will not be sent separately. Candidates should visit hartron.org.in regularly and download their admit cards when the facility becomes available.

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Interested and eligible candidates can apply for the Data Entry Operator panel from 13 November to 22 November 2026 . Official Website: hartron.org.in Application Start Date: 13 November 2026. Last Date: 22 November 2026. Applicants should select only one district and ensure they meet the educational, computer qualification and typing requirements.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for HARTRON DEO Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Important: Candidates can apply for only one district. Incorrect reservation claims or the absence of supporting documents may lead to the application being considered under the General/parent category, subject to eligibility, or to cancellation where required by the rules.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for HARTRON DEO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The following documents may be required for application submission and eligibility verification, depending on the qualification route and category claimed: Class 10 certificate and marksheet. Class 12 certificate and marksheet, where applicable. Graduation certificate and marksheets, where applicable. BCA/B.Sc. Computer Science/IT certificate, where applicable. Three-year Diploma certificate, where applicable. 'O' Level or one-year Computer Course certificate, where applicable. Office Management and Computer Applications Diploma, where applicable. ITI/NCVT Stenography certificate, where applicable. Haryana residence/domicile proof for applicable reservation claims. DSC/OSC/BCA/BCB/EWS reservation certificate, where applicable. PwD certificate, where applicable. Ex-Servicemen or family eligibility documents, where applicable. Valid photo identity proof. Recent photograph and signature in the portal-prescribed format. Other documents requested by HARTRON for verification. Document Cut-Off: Candidates claiming eligibility or reservation must possess the relevant qualification and certificates by the closing date, as required under the supplied guidelines.

content_sections.heading: HARTRON DEO Panel Validity and Deployment Rules
content_sections.text: The selected Data Entry Operator panel will remain valid for two years from the date of publication of the result on HARTRON's official website. HARTRON reserves the right to extend the panel period if required. However, inclusion in the panel does not guarantee deployment. Actual deployment will be made only after HARTRON receives confirmed manpower requirements from the concerned organization or department. Important: These are panel positions for engagement on a job-work basis. Candidates should not treat empanelment as a permanent appointment or a guaranteed joining order.

faq.question: Q4. Which districts have vacancies under HARTRON DEO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The vacancies are available in Gurugram, Jhajjar, Karnal, Palwal, Rewari, Sonepat and Panchkula. Panchkula has 50 positions, while each of the other six districts has 10 positions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for HARTRON Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: Candidates must meet one of the prescribed qualification routes, including 10+2 with a computer course, a three-year Diploma, BCA, B.Sc. Computer Science/IT or relevant alternative qualifications, along with the prescribed typing speed.

faq.answer: Yes. Class 12 pass candidates with at least 50% marks and the required 'O' Level or one-year computer course qualification can apply under the relevant route.

faq.answer: The prescribed data punching speed is 9,000 key depressions per hour or 30 words per minute.
